sessionCookie.name: zhixu_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict browser Session cookie. Unsafe requests also require the X-CSRF-Token header and an exact allowed Origin.

apiBearer.description: A scoped, revocable API Token. It cannot bypass Proposal/Approval/Write Authorization.

bootstrapBearer.description: Runtime-only bootstrap credential accepted only by POST /api/v1/auth/sessions.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Required for unsafe requests authenticated by the Session cookie. Bearer API Token requests do not use CSRF.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: The exact configured allowed Origin, without leading or trailing whitespace. Required for unsafe requests authenticated by the Session cookie.

schema.description: Opaque Collection cursor bound to Workspace, query, limit and read-model revision.

ETag.description: Weak resource projection tag. Answer tags bind Answer, Workflow and persisted RAG stage projections.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired, revoked or invalid authentication credential.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal lacks the required Capability or failed Origin/CSRF validation.

BadRequest.description: Invalid strict JSON, identifier, cursor or option.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: JSON command body did not use application/json.

NotFound.description: Resource absent or outside the supplied Workspace; both are indistinguishable.

Conflict.description: Idempotency, lifecycle, active workflow or event cursor conflict.

Gone.description: The requested result has expired and is no longer downloadable.

csrf_token.description: Returned on Session creation or rotation and required on unsafe cookie-authenticated requests.

expires_in_seconds.description: Zero uses the configured API Token TTL.

token.description: Plaintext API Token returned exactly once.

content_artifact_created.description: True when this scan published the managed immutable bytes; false when an identical artifact was reused.

graph.description: Deprecated compatibility field; must match the server-registered canonical graph.

ProposalRiskLevel.description: Explicit immutable Proposal-level approval and list-filter fact. Revision risk remains an independent free-form explanation and never derives this level.

target_path.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path; absolute paths, backslashes and traversal are rejected.

Approval.description: Persistent Approval snapshot returned by Proposal detail and list reads. New approved file_patch snapshots include the durable Git and Workflow binding. Historical approved file_patch snapshots may omit workflow_run_id/workflow_status_url while awaiting an exact approval replay; snapshots that also omit approved_git_head are read-only manual-recovery records. Approved non-file typed Proposal snapshots and rejected snapshots omit all Git and Workflow fields. The transient dispatch_status exists only on ApprovalDecisionResponse.

NonFileApproval.description: Approval snapshot for a non-file typed Proposal. Git and Safe Writeback Workflow fields are forbidden.

ApprovalDecisionResponse.description: Approved file_patch decisions include approved_git_head, workflow_run_id, workflow_status_url and dispatch_status. Approved non-file typed Proposal decisions and rejected decisions omit all Git and Workflow writeback fields.

PublishArtifactBinding.description: Frozen Artifact publication binding. The three identifiers are pairwise distinct and source_coverage has unique section keys.

PublishArtifactProposal.description: A frozen Artifact publication request. Approval alone does not create a Document, write Git, or update the index.

SearchCursor.description: Opaque process-lifetime HMAC cursor bound to the canonical request, Active Index and complete top-100 result fingerprint. Clients restart from the first page after an invalid or stale cursor.

query.description: After trimming leading and trailing whitespace, the query must be non-empty, valid UTF-8, contain no NUL code point, and use at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes. maxLength remains a conservative code-point bound; x-max-utf8-bytes is the authoritative byte limit.

VectorDistance.description: The raw distance produced by the Active Embedding Version's persisted pgvector distance operator; lower ranks first and values are not comparable across models.

index_status.description: Current Active Index selection for this Source. included binds this Source Version; excluded is Source-scoped.

GraphCanonicalJSONObject.description: Canonical applicability JSON object. Arbitrary keys are allowed, but the server rejects duplicate keys, invalid Unicode, excessive depth and oversized payloads.

status_url.description: Workspace-scoped authoritative Semantic Link Scan projection URL; workflow_run_id remains the runtime binding.
Workspace-scoped self URL for this durable Scan projection.

PageCursor.description: Opaque versioned base64url cursor bound to the resource and sort order.

question.description: Non-blank UTF-8 text, at most 8192 bytes, with no NUL.

base_hash_match.description: True exactly when current_hash equals base_hash.

ArtifactPublication.description: Frozen PUBLISH_ARTIFACT Proposal binding. Formal knowledge remains unchanged until Change Control approval and execution.

index_status.description: Active Index selection. included binds this Source Version; excluded is Source-scoped and therefore applies to every historical version of the excluded Source.

next_cursor.description: Opaque HMAC cursor bound to Workspace, canonical filters and page size.

dispatch_pending.description: True only when the durable PENDING job exists but immediate River dispatch was not confirmed.

ReviewDueCardSummary.description: Deliberately redacted card projection for the pre-answer due queue. It never contains answer points, evidence, claim identity, model metadata, invalidation metadata or card timestamps.

question_ref.description: Opaque server-signed binding of the active Review Session, current card content and schedule snapshot.

ReviewInvalidationResult.description: Bounded invalidation batch. When has_more is true, repeat the same selector with a new Idempotency-Key until it becomes false.

Memory.description: Owner and confirmation-principal identities are intentionally omitted from the user-facing Memory wire model.

InterviewQuestion.description: Participant question projection. Canonical answer_points are deliberately not present.

InterviewTurn.description: Raw user_answer and request receipt identity are deliberately excluded from recovery projections.

CreateDownstreamUpdateProposalRequest.description: Selects exactly one owner-backed target from the current impact-report/v2. Unknown or duplicate JSON fields are rejected by the HTTP boundary.

DownstreamUpdate.description: Frozen approval intent. The payload is not an apply command and never carries a write authorization or Workflow binding.

DownstreamUpdateProposal.description: An approval-only downstream owner update intent. Approved responses remain non-executable and omit every Git, Workflow, write-authorization and writeback field.

DownstreamUpdateProposalCreateResponse.description: Endpoint-only downstream Proposal response. replayed is intentionally absent from Proposal detail and list resources.

dispatch_pending.description: True only when the durable PENDING job exists but immediate River dispatch was not confirmed.
